reuse.why: Introduces a shared category selector and folds the three avg actions into one helper, but the helper re-inlines the average-and-sign logic of the existing setNMonthAvg instead of calling it, and copyPreviousMonth's getBudgetData path is not reused/extended.

duplication.why: Removes the three copied SQL queries, yet setBulkNMonthAvg duplicates setNMonthAvg's getCategoryAverage + income sign flip, and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own separate hidden filter.

placement.why: Selection helper and bulk-average helper live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions; the 3/6/12 consolidation is related refactoring, test added.

maintainability.why: Cleaner for setZero and averages, but the rule is not applied to copyPreviousMonth, so a month-wide action still overwrites template categories and the hidden rule lives in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setBulkNMonthAvg in actions.ts re-implements setNMonthAvg (average + sign) instead of calling it.

disguised_duplication.where: setBulkNMonthAvg reshapes setNMonthAvg's average/sign-flip body into a loop rather than sharing it.

one_place.where: getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction covers setZero and the N-month averages, but copyPreviousMonth still filters hidden/group_hidden itself via getBudgetData and has no template check.
